title: NASA's Neptune fact sheet: orbit 60,189.018 days, 16 satellites
summary: The sheet lists Neptune's mass as 102.409 × 10^24 kg, sidereal orbit 60,189.018 days, equatorial radius at the 1-bar level 24,764 km, mean density 1,638 kg/m^3, and 16 natural satellites.
body: The sheet lists Neptune's mass as 102.409 × 10^24 kg, sidereal orbit 60,189.018 days, equatorial radius at the 1-bar level 24,764 km, mean density 1,638 kg/m^3, and 16 natural satellites. It lists a planetary ring system as Yes. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last updated on the page: 2024-10-03.
